notes.title: Upcoming update and DLC
notes.content: [h3]Hi everyone! Now preparing an update to the game that will slightly change its state.[/h3][p]What do you mean by state change? The game will no longer have the levels that were there, but will now have [b]chapters as separate levels with their own unique mechanics and locations[/b]. With the new update will come a new chapter as well as new DLC![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for understanding.[/p]

notes.title: The Winter House DLC is out now
notes.content: In the new addition you will have to escape from your home in the cold forest. Keep an eye on the temperature and the monster from the forest who wants you dead.

notes.title: Welcome to the nightclub...
notes.content:
Welcome to the nightclub scene of a rapidly growing and crime-ridden city. You have the opportunity to create the best and most popular club in the whole city!

Sounds easy, maybe. But the world is against you. Gangs, police and other representatives of warring factions will put forward their conditions, and how to deal with it is up to you.

It's important to mention the music, because it's the main part of your nightclub. Play your own music or choose one of the suggested ones.

Serve drinks, manage prices, break up fights and a lot more.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
The first major update after the release of the game! During this time we have prepared a lot of new content and new items. After studying the feedback from testers and players, as well as analyzing the game, we came to the decision that we need to change and improve a lot of things. 

Meet Uncle's Basement - 1.1!

[b][h1]Uncle's Basement 1.1[/h1][/b]

- Expansion of locations
[list]
[*] Added Laboratory
[*] Added Monolith Room
[*] Weapon room added
[*] Added damaged hotel location
[/list].
- New escape routes
[list]
[*] Monolith Exit Passage
[/list]
- New items
[list]
[*] Walkie-talkie
[*] Homemade bomb
[*] Computer
[*] Monolith
[*] Security cameras
[/list]
- Interface Enhancements
[list]
[*] New main menu
[*] New pause menu
[/list]
- Fixed minor bugs
- New achievements added

notes.title: Uncle's Basement - Collector's Pack is out
notes.content:
This DLC added over 20 different collectibles such as Halloween pumpkins, Easter eggs and fantasy characters!
Will you be able to find and collect them all while your uncle is after you?
Once you do, you will be rewarded with an achievement. A worthy reward, right?

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
In version 1.0.1 we have added, fixed and improved the game:
[list]
[*] Added the ability to use cheats, for fun of course.
In this version you can become invincible.
You can also shorten your enemies, literally. They will become shorter and fatter (it looks funny).

[*] Improved the sound of the gramophone, now you can enjoy the music properly.

[*] Fixed a bug with passing through an enemy.
[/list]

notes.title: Uncle's Basement Is Released!
notes.content:
Uncle's Basement is available to play!

We will support the game by releasing DLC and big updates. We would also like to thank those who added our game to their wishlist. More content and cool games are waiting for us in the future!
